items.t: “차량 격파·흉기 든 괴한 퇴치”…中유니트리, 만능캐 로봇 공개
items.d: 중국 휴머노이드 로봇 기업인 유니트리가 고난도 무술 동작을 구현하는 ‘쿵푸 로봇’을 공개했다.유니트리가 21일(현지시간) 공개한 휴머노이드 로봇 H2-X 시연 영상을 보면 로봇이 승용차를 뛰어넘어 안정적으로 착지하고 발과 팔을 이용해 승용차를 타격한다. 이어 H2-X가 발과 팔로 가격한 자동차 문과 보닛이 찌그러진 모습이 나온다.폐차장으로 장소를 옮긴 로봇은 4m 높이의 컨테이너에서 뛰어 내리고 안정적으로 착지한 후 돌려차기와 같은 고난도 동작을 선보인다.유니트리는 이번 영상을 통해 휴머노이드 로봇이 흉기를 든 괴한으로부터 주인을 경호하는 장면을 연출해 눈길을 끌었다.흉기를 든 남성이 울타리를 넘어 정원에서 독서하고 있던 여성에게 접근하자 빠른 속도로 괴한을 막아서고 돌려차기를 해 여성을 안전하게 보호한다.

items.fullText: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models New tools joining NVIDIA Cosmos are helping accelerate data pipelines, train, evaluate and optimize world models more efficiently, and improve accuracy at lower cost. October 21, 2026 by Pranjali Joshi 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! To help developers rapidly build world models , which help physical AI systems understand and simulate the real world, NVIDIA has expanded the Cosmos platform with new training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints. Ranking top five on six different open models leaderboards, the NVIDIA Cosmos platform gives world model builders the frontier open models — as well as data, training and optimization tools and recipes — to scale training data, adapt models, test behavior and optimize for performance before deployment. Build Better Training Data Building world models begins with multimodal, multisensory data. NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory brings together the tools and skills for labeling, curating, augmenting and evaluating data at scale for training physical AI. Cosmos Curator, a GPU-accelerated solution for curating video training datasets, has now added support for multimodal multisensory inputs and processing blocks. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Cosmos Data Factory now offers the following five cloud-native blueprints and is available through GitHub , Microsoft Azure , Nebius and CoreWeave : Autonomous Vehicle Dataset Generation: Curates and labels driving data, then adds synthetic examples of hard-to-capture scenarios to expand training coverage. Image Attribute Augmentation: Varies object appearance to improve image search. Event Video Generation: Turns still images into synthetic videos of rare or unsafe events. Tesla starts Optimus robot production in California as profit falls 43%
items.d: Tesla's revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed as it pressed the accelerator on its Optimus robots, AI, and autonomous driving.
items.fullText: Tesla has started production of its Optimus humanoid robot at its factory in Fremont, California, in a manufacturing space once dedicated to making electric vehicles, the company announced Wednesday. “The bots coming off this line are the first production-quality bots that we have manufactured,” Tesla wrote in its third-quarter letter to shareholders. “While we will continue to iterate on the hardware and manufacturing process, we have proven that the current manufacturing process for Optimus is suitable for a commercial product.” Tesla CEO Elon Musk said on a conference call that he considers this “early production” and that the ramp will be slow and “somewhat bumpy because it is such a radically new product.” He nonetheless claimed Tesla will be able to make 20,000 of them per week by the end of 2027. “There’s still some things we need to tweak about the design, because you need to deliver a robot that is safe and reliable and has long duration, so it can’t, like, wear out after a month,” he said. “And there’s still quite a lot of work to do with regard to the AI and the robot for it to be truly useful for open-ended tasks.” That forward-looking development wasn’t enough to lift the company’s otherwise middling third-quarter earnings, results that typify a company in the midst of a major bet. Tesla’s revenue was flat and its expenses skyrocketed as it pressed the accelerator on its Optimus robots, AI, and autonomous driving. The end result was a 43% drop in profits. The company’s revenue was largely driven by EV sales, which were flat year-over-year at $20 billion. Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter, about 6,000 more than the previous quarter, but fewer than in the same period last year. items.fullText: NVIDIA Open Models Advance Europe’s Sovereign Intelligence Across Industries New model families for vision and language, retrieval, tabular data, biology, robotics and quantum computing supercharge development in Europe. October 21, 2026 by Kari Briski 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries The portfolio includes the new NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt models; new NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models for embedding, reranking and document parsing; the new NVIDIA Kumo family open weight foundation models and libraries for structured business data; NVIDIA Cosmos 3.5 world models; NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge for autonomous vehicles; NVIDIA BioNeMo for healthcare and scientific discovery; and NVIDIA Ising for quantum computing. The open models give organizations a foundation they can customize with local data and deploy on infrastructure they control. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA Nemotron Powers Post-Training Across Industries NVIDIA Nemotron brings open language models, datasets and recipes to developers building agents. The models support text and images, helping agents orchestrate workflows, reason through complex problems and complete specialized tasks at a lower cost. Nemotron models are built with data, research and expertise from the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition , including European partners Black Forest Labs , H-Company and Mistral . Nemotron provides a foundation for enterprises to build applications based on their own knowledge and expertise. items.fullText: GTC Berlin 2026: Live Updates From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s Keynote October 21, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Founded in a tent near the Berlin Wall in 1980, the Tempodrom moved several times before settling near Anhalter Bahnhof in 2001. Its permanent home has since hosted concerts, galas and political events. Today, it hosts a different kind of spectacle. GTC Berlin runs three days, with more than 100 sessions on agentic AI, robotics, physical AI, open models and accelerated computing underway at STATION-Berlin down the road. Here, journalists, analysts and partners have gathered for the main event: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote. Huang Takes the Stage Huang opened with a question: What do L’Oréal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé and HSBC have in common? They’re all European companies and they’re all working with NVIDIA on AI, he said. The keynote comes on the heels of NVIDIA’s weeklong road across Europe — Paris, London, Stockholm, Dublin — with the company committing nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem across Europe and working with 12,000+ partners. “After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements AI is a five-layer cake , Huang explained. Energy powers advanced computers that are part of an AI factory, which generates tokens and digital intelligence from the models that run on it, which are then integrated into every application. “Long before the AI models emerge, the infrastructure has to exist,” he said, highlighting how, similarly, the internet first needed networking, and electricity first required the grid. “To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI,” Huang said. “We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.” The AI Fac
